item.title: Cloudflare Expands Quantum-Safe Government Security Platform With FedRAMP High Authorization
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET), the leading connectivity cloud company, today announced that Cloudflare for Government achieved the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP®) High certification and GovRAMP™ Moderate authorization. These achievements enable Federal, State and Local government, defense, education and highly-regulated organizations to use Cloudflare’s suite of integrated security, performance, AI and developer services to […]
